statement.p: How many anagrams are there of academia?

solution.p: First, decide where to put the as. There are 8 positions, and we must choose 3 of them to fill with an a. This can be done in \binom{8}{3} ways. The remaining 5 spots all get a different letter, so there are 5! ways to finish off the anagram. This gives a total of \binom{8}{3}\cdot 5! anagrams. Strangely enough, this is 6720, which is also equal to P(8,5)\text{.} To get the answer that way, start by picking one of the 8 positions to be filled by the first non-a letter, one of the remaining 7 positions to be filled by the next, and so on. Then put as in the remaining 3 positions.
